from PIL import Image

img1 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0001.png"))
# lamp shade:

# Lamp pole in 1:
ys_p, xs_p = np.where((img1[:,:,0]>60)&(img1[:,:,0]<110)&(img1[:,:,1]>60)&(img1[:,:,1]<110)&(img1[:,:,2]>60)&(img1[:,:,2]<110)&(np.arange(512)[None,:]>400)&(np.arange(512)[:,None]>250))

print("lamp base in 1: bottom v =", ys_b.max(), "u =", xs_b[ys_b==ys_b.max()].mean())

    theta = np.radians(heading_deg)
    z_cam = 1.55 * 256.0 / (v - 256.0)

    X_w = X_cam + z_cam * np.sin(theta) + x_cam * np.cos(theta)
    Y_w = Y_cam + z_cam * np.cos(theta) - x_cam * np.sin(theta)
    return X_w, Y_w

print("lamp in 1 world:", ground_to_world(xs_b[ys_b==ys_b.max()].mean(), ys_b.max(), 0, 0, 0))
